min_severity_meaning: P0 (data loss, auth bypass, money), P1 (core task broken for a large group) and P2 (core task degraded) are queued. P3 polish is not.

focus_specific: Stop when design_system_violations has not decreased for 3 consecutive iterations.

reserved_for_human: A redesign cutover is never auto-approved.
Any finding touching auth, payments or the database schema requires explicit approval.
